PRIVATE AI LEAD CONVERSION

Give each lead the context it deserves.

Campaign responses arrive across channels. DealTailor™ uses the approved business context to understand the enquiry, respond personally and move the conversation towards an appropriate next action.

01

Understand the enquiry

Combine campaign context, permitted public-profile signals and the conversation so far.

02

Respond with business knowledge

Use approved offerings, policies, differentiators and domain context to shape relevant responses.

03

Qualify and progress

Clarify intent, fit, urgency and missing information; guide the lead towards a demo, meeting or human assistance.

04

Hand over the useful picture

Give sales a concise summary, relevant context and a recommended next step through configured CRM or ERP integrations.

PRIVATE AI ADVANTAGE

Useful intelligence.
Defined boundaries.

DealTailor™ brings approved business knowledge into a controlled engagement environment.

Customer-controlled deployment

Design the environment around approved business knowledge, data access and operating policies.

AWS-managed model access

Use approved managed language models, with model, region, logging and retention settings agreed for the deployment.

Administrator-led boundaries

Define who can use the system, which data they can access and how integrations and knowledge updates are governed.

Privacy and access controls depend on the agreed deployment configuration and connected services. Validate permissions, data handling and human escalation before rollout.

A PRACTICAL WAY FORWARD

From understanding to action.

01

Define the offer

Agree the campaign, customer journey and intended outcomes.

02

Curate the knowledge

Prepare approved business content, boundaries and escalation rules.

03

Connect approved channels

Configure channel APIs and the required CRM or ERP handoffs.

04

Validate the conversation

Review realistic enquiries, exceptions and human handover before rollout.

Scope & fit

Deployment, connected channels, external information and CRM/ERP handoffs follow the agreed configuration and approved access. AWS-managed model access and customer-controlled administration are part of the deployment design; privacy depends on model, region, logging, retention and integration settings. Governed knowledge updates do not imply automatic retraining of the base model.
